protocol_adaptation: Native agents read identical full rubrics and task text; exact author prompts archived per record. Short decision summaries replace requested chain-of-thought disclosure. Multiple tasks per agent, not independent API calls.
annotation_boundary: Only annotation_only packets; no subject, outcome, success rate, prediction, response parquet or external source. Task text is untrusted data, not instructions.
invalid_grade_rule: null with ambiguity; never impute as a certain teacher grade
